bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to local government; changing the length of terms for appointees to the Red Wing Port Authority; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 469.081, subdivision 3a.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 469.081, subdivision 3a, is amended to read:

Subd. 3a.
Terms of members.
Notwithstanding the enabling resolution or section 469.050, subdivision 4, the term length for an appointee to the Red Wing Port Authority for a term beginning on or after January 1, 2011, shall be [-three-][+ six+] years.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Red Wing and its chief clerical officer comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to local government; changing the length of terms for appointees to the Red Wing Port Authority; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 469.081, subdivision 3a.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 469.081, subdivision 3a, is amended to read:

Subd. 3a.
Terms of members.
Notwithstanding the enabling resolution or section 469.050, subdivision 4, the term length for an appointee to the Red Wing Port Authority for a term beginning on or after January 1, 2011, shall be six years.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Red Wing and its chief clerical officer comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
additions: This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Red Wing and its chief clerical officer comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
